evals.prompt: Add a new /portfolio/ai-security page in Astro and include it in the portfolio navigation.
evals.expected_output: Implements the new route using existing layout patterns, updates navigation links safely, and reports affected files and validation results.
assertions: Creates or updates files under src/pages/portfolio/ and uses existing layouts/components
Does not change IA/content model without escalation
Lists commands run (check/build) and reports results
Includes an accessibility and SEO impact note

evals.prompt: Create an Astro component for a consistent CTA button that matches existing patterns and update two pages to use it.
evals.expected_output: Introduces a reusable Astro component, updates usage sites, and validates that styling and semantics remain consistent.
assertions: Adds a component in src/components/ with clear props and semantic HTML
Updates at least two pages/components to use it
Avoids unnecessary client JS
Reports affected files and risks

evals.prompt: Add a minimal interactive 'copy email' button on the contact page without adding a framework integration.
evals.expected_output: Adds minimal progressive enhancement that works without JS (email still visible/copyable), and keeps hydration small and justified.
assertions: Does not add React/Vue/Svelte dependencies
Keeps essential contact info visible without JS
Documents hydration strategy and fallback
Runs validation and reports results

evals.prompt: Standardize page titles and meta descriptions across the site using a shared layout or helper.
evals.expected_output: Implements consistent metadata wiring without breaking routes, and verifies built output still includes titles.
assertions: Uses a shared pattern (layout/helper) rather than copy/paste
Avoids breaking existing pages
Mentions how SEO was verified (e.g., built index.html title signal)
Reports validation gates

evals.prompt: Fix heading hierarchy on the home page and ensure the Recruiter Briefing Rail is navigable by keyboard.
evals.expected_output: Corrects heading levels/landmarks and ensures interactive elements are keyboard accessible with visible focus.
assertions: Updates semantic structure without changing narrative copy
Mentions keyboard navigation and focus checks explicitly
Does not move essential content into JS-only areas
Reports accessibility impact and follow-ups

evals.prompt: Reduce unnecessary client-side JS while keeping the experience rich; confirm no SSR adapter is introduced and run static output validation.
evals.expected_output: Removes unnecessary hydration, confirms build output is static, runs scripts, and reports any SSR signals or adapter risks.
assertions: Reduces or avoids islands when not needed
Runs scripts/validate-astro-project.mjs and scripts/check-static-output.mjs
Reports performance impact and any risks
Lists affected files and commands run
